compositionSources.whatItSupplies: the 1 required-before-filing supporting document(s) and the 11 self-help stop condition(s) printed in participant-instructions.md. fi05IdentityReadFromTheDocument.whyItWasRead: this family stopped BLOCKED_SOURCE because official-form:FI-05 matched zero committed index entries by form number: it lives in the Nationwide recovery pool, whose 380 entries all carry formNumber null. The resolver now confirms the pinned digest against the committed index instead. A matching digest proves the bytes are the bytes somebody pinned, not that they are the document this family means, so the document itself was read.
